map.羊水指数（AFI）正常范围 使用指南: Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) Normal Range — User Guide
map.支持四象限羊水指数（AFI）与最大垂直羊水池（MVP）两种测量模式，快速判断羊水: Supports both four-quadrant AFI and maximum vertical pocket (MVP) modes to quickly judge amniotic fluid volume.
map.AFI = 四象限羊水池深度之和；MVP = 最大垂直羊水池深度: AFI = sum of the four-quadrant pocket depths; MVP = maximum vertical pocket depth
map.AFI 25 cm 羊水过多；MVP 8 过多。: AFI > 25 cm indicates polyhydramnios; MVP > 8 indicates excess.
map.超声测 AFI 判断羊水量是否正常。: Use ultrasound AFI to judge whether fluid volume is normal.
map.AFI 临界或异常时决定复查与干预。: Decide re-check and intervention when AFI is borderline or abnormal.
map.胎膜早破/胎儿畸形排查。: Screen for premature rupture of membranes / fetal malformation.
map.：四象限 4+4+5+3 = 16cm，落在 8–25cm 正常区间，继续常规产: : four quadrants 4+4+5+3 = 16 cm, within the normal 8–25 cm range; continue routine prenatal care.
map.：AFI 4.5cm（<5）：判羊水过少，排查胎膜早破与泌尿系统畸形，足月可考虑: : AFI 4.5 cm (<5): oligohydramnios; screen for premature rupture and urinary-tract malformation; at term, consider delivery.
map.AFI 正常范围是多少？: What is the normal AFI range?
map.一般 8–25cm 为正常；5–8cm 临界偏少、<5cm 过少、>25cm 过: Generally 8–25 cm is normal; 5–8 cm borderline low, <5 cm too little, >25 cm too much, with slight guideline differences.
map.过少和过多分别警惕什么？: What to watch for with too little or too much?
map.过少警惕胎膜早破、胎儿畸形、胎盘功能减退；过多警惕妊娠期糖尿病、胎儿消化道畸形，: Too little: watch for membrane rupture, fetal malformation, placental dysfunction; too much: watch for gestational diabetes, fetal GI malformation—both need further evaluation.
